hook_desc.memory-approve: Guards writes to your beats files.
hook_desc.memory-nudge: Reminds you to write a beat after each change.
hook_desc.memory-compact: Keeps the beats index under its load budget.
hook_desc.beats-rebuild: Recompiles the beats search index in the background.
hook_desc.beats-staleness-guard: Verifies the beats index at session start.
hook_desc.reflect-nudge: Suggests a reflect pass when new beats pile up.
hook_desc.sidecoach-keyword: Watches for design intent and nudges sidecoach.
hook_desc.sidecoach-sessionstart: Loads sidecoach context at session start.
hook_desc.justify-source-guard: Blocks edits to generated justify artifacts.
hook_desc.justify-watch-guard: Keeps the justify watch loop alive.
hook_desc.justify-watch-standing-by: Corrects the false "finished" line when the watch parks.
hook_desc.agent-teams-guard: Gates the Agent tool inside cmux team sessions.
hook_desc.node-shim-heal: Re-plants the cmux node preload shim.
hook_desc.cmux-close-guard: Protects cmux panes from an accidental close.
hook_desc.cmux-teammate-shim-heal: Restores the cmux teammate tmux shim.
hook_desc.team-reaper: Cleans up dead agent-team state dirs.
hook_desc.resume-guard: Blocks cmux auto-resume when you opt out.
hook_desc.visualizer-guard: Gates the show_widget tool for quality + surface.
hook_desc.codex-failure-watcher: Detects codex CLI failures and flags them.
hook_desc.chrome-tabgroup-track: Records the Chrome tab groups you open.
hook_desc.chrome-tabgroup-clear: Clears the record when you close a group.
hook_desc.chrome-tabgroup-stop: Nudges you to close tab groups before quitting.
hook_desc.figma-fidelity-stop: Blocks "done" until Figma parity is proven.
hook_desc.bash-guard: Blocks forbidden shell patterns and force-pushes.
hook_desc.content-guard: Blocks banned content in writes (emojis, dashes, attribution).
hook_desc.content-guard-stop: Re-checks written content at stop time.
hook_desc.verify-clear: Clears the verification flag once met.
hook_desc.verify-manual: Lets you mark manual verification done.
hook_desc.screenshot-open-mandate: Requires reading a screenshot after capture.
hook_desc.screenshot-open-clear: Clears the screenshot-pending flag on read.
hook_desc.second-fix-gate: Warns on a second fix before the first is verified.
hook_desc.multiple-choice-detect-stop: Flags plain-text questions at stop time.
hook_desc.multiple-choice-enforce: Detects option lists that should use the picker.
hook_desc.grounding-gate: Requires grounding claims in real evidence.
hook_desc.api-drift-detector: Detects drifted or renamed API calls.
hook_desc.api-drift-stop: Enforces the API-drift check at stop.
hook_desc.api-drift-ack: Records your acknowledgement of a drift.
hook_desc.plan-consistency-lint: Checks a plan against the current commit.
hook_desc.push-ahead-check: Guards against pushing ahead of review.
hook_desc.claude-surface: Detects the Claude Code surface (rich vs text).
hook_desc.surface-visual-gate: Nudges visual output on rich surfaces.
hook_desc.model-router-guard: Routes behavior by the session model.
hook_desc.resume-toggle: Flips cmux auto-resume from a chat command.
hook_desc.teammate-relay-stop: Stops a teammate idling with an unsent report.
hook_desc.sidecoach-preamble: Injects PRODUCT.md + DESIGN.md into every session.
hook_desc.sidecoach-postuserp: Sends your prompt to the sidecoach daemon.
hook_desc.sidecoach-taste-gate: Reviews UI files the moment they are written.
hook_desc.sidecoach-postresponse: Folds sidecoach daemon results into the reply.
